function pick(this: { tag: "text" }): string;
function pick(this: { tag: "number" }): number;
function pick(this: { tag: string }): any { return this.tag === "text" ? "word" : 2; }

const textReceiver = { tag: "text" as const, pick };
const numberReceiver = { tag: "number" as const, pick };
interface NumberReceiver {
  tag: "number";
  pick(this: { tag: "text" }): string;
  pick(this: { tag: "number" }): number;
}
const annotated: NumberReceiver = numberReceiver;
console.log(textReceiver.pick().toUpperCase(), numberReceiver.pick().toFixed(), annotated.pick().toFixed());
